players.product: AI-enabled antibody and drug discovery programs

quarterly_data.signal: Lilly broke ground on a new $5 billion manufacturing facility west of Richmond, Virginia (Goochland County), one of 10 new U.S. manufacturing sites announced since 2020 and one of five that will produce active pharmaceutical ingredients; it will be Lilly's first site to produce both API and finished medicines in a fully integrated facility, with dedicated API capacity for bioconjugate and large-molecule medicines, and will produce antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs). It is part of Lilly's more than $50 billion push to expand U.S. medicine production and is expected to create 650 jobs; the release says the site will use machine learning, AI and digitally integrated systems.
